# peernode_kubernetes_kubeconfig (Resource)

An admin kubeconfig for a cluster. Every issue creates a new token and **revokes the previous one** (also one downloaded from the dashboard), so keep one of these per cluster. Change `keepers` to rotate the token. Destroying the resource only forgets the kubeconfig; the token stays valid until the next one is issued or the cluster is deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peernode_kubernetes_kubeconfig" "web" {
  cluster_id = peernode_kubernetes_cluster.web.id
  # Change to rotate the token (the previous kubeconfig stops working).
  keepers = { rotation = "2026-11" }
}

provider "kubernetes" {
  config_path = local_sensitive_file.kubeconfig.filename
}

resource "local_sensitive_file" "kubeconfig" {
  content  = peernode_kubernetes_kubeconfig.web.kubeconfig
  filename = "${path.module}/web.kubeconfig"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.

### Optional

- `keepers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; changing any of them issues a new kubeconfig (token rotation).

### Read-Only

- `filename` (String) Suggested file name.
- `id` (String) Same as `cluster_id`.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) The kubeconfig (YAML).
